name: categories-benchmark-eval
description:
Within each bench there are 

data folder
files contain the candidate models' labels in the field "category_tag".


ground truth files.
contain ground truth labels by larger models in the field "label"
vote files contain labels calculated from the votes of claude-3-7-sonnet, deepseek-r1, gemini-2.0-pro, and gpt-4.5
vote_2 : true if >= 2 models vote true
vote_3 : true if >= 3 models vote true
individual votes are specified in the field "votes"
evaluation_method: accuracy (and vote-based agreement with ground truth labels)
reputation: Hugging Face-hosted dataset used for label-agreement and calibration analyses; a niche but practical resource for model ensemble / label-consensus studies.
